title: From Author to Learner
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: MicroSims
Publishing
MkDocs
Git
GitHub Pages
Content Delivery Network
description: A Mermaid top-to-bottom workflow of the seven steps that take a MicroSim from an author's files to a learner's browser; clicking a step shows its command or tool and a common failure, and hovering an arrow shows the artifact passed along.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

educational.topic: Publishing a MicroSim with MkDocs, Git and GitHub Pages
learningObjectives: The learner will summarize the path a MicroSim takes from an author's files to a learner's browser.

accessibility.notes: Info panel is an aria-live region; phase colors are paired with a text legend

controls.label: Seven workflow steps
controls.purpose: Show the command or tool and what could go wrong

controls.label: Six arrows
controls.purpose: Show the artifact passed to the next step

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Process walkthrough with failure modes at each step
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Clickable workflow with an info panel and arrow tooltips
keyQuestions: Which step first turns Markdown into HTML pages for readers?
Why do absolute paths break on GitHub Pages?
commonMisconceptions: mkdocs gh-deploy builds from the GitHub copy rather than the local copy
A MicroSim that works in mkdocs serve will always work when deployed
assessmentOpportunities: Three-sentence summary naming all phases in order
Locating the step where a given failure starts
